commentary_title: Weak demand to weigh on VLCC rates in the East
commentary_summary: The VLCC tonne-miles index remained stable at around 100.1 points in week 35. The global ballast speed declined last week, as vessel speeds slowed down towards the West amid increased traffic at the ports. | Tonnage demand in the MEG-East weakened last week which is expected to weigh on freight rates. | Towards the West, ex-USG route rates saw an uptick as tonnage supply was tight. There is likely to be an increase in underway ballast vessels next week.
